hypothesis: Modified nucleosides combined with lipid nanoparticle delivery will reduce mRNA immunogenicity while maintaining stability for vaccine applications
prediction: The immunogenicity of modified mRNA delivered via lipid nanoparticles will be 70% lower than unmodified mRNA delivered via the same method
measurement_method: Measure immune response markers (e.g., cytokine levels) in animal models after administering modified vs unmodified mRNA-LNP formulations
falsification_condition: If the modified mRNA-LNP shows less than 35% reduction in immunogenicity compared to unmodified mRNA-LNP
